responsibility: Implements the default traversal behavior for the Rust HIR visitor framework. This file provides `DefaultHIRVisitor::walk` and related helper routines for the full range of lowered HIR node kinds—paths, generic arguments, expressions, items, patterns, statements, bounds, and types—by recursively visiting each node’s owned substructure, attributes, lifetimes, parameters, clauses, and nested child nodes through `accept_vis`. Its role is not to define the visitor API itself, but to supply the reusable tree-walking semantics that analyses, dumps, and other HIR passes can inherit and selectively override instead of manually recursing through every HIR class.
same_name_distinction: Defines the .cc-side behavior for the visitor framework declared in rust-hir-visitor.h: it implements DefaultHIRVisitor’s concrete tree-walking recursion over HIR nodes and helper traversal routines, whereas the same-stem header provides the visitor class/interface declarations and dispatch contracts.
